name: Vector de Coherencia de Color
description: Differentiates spatially coherent vs. incoherent color distribución. AI images tend to have unnaturally high color coherencia in regions.
mechanism: Classifies each pixel as coherent or incoherent based on connected component membership relative to region size umbral. Computes ratio entre coherent and incoherent pixels per color bin.
parameters: Color quantization: 64 bins, Coherence umbral: 25 pixels, Connected components: 4-connectivity
source: Pass, G. et al. (1996) — Histogram Refinement for Content-Based Image Retrieval, ACM MM Workshop
useCase: Detecting overly uniform color regions in generado por IA images

references.title: Pass, G. et al. (1996). Histogram Refinement for Content-Based Image Retrieval. ACM Multimedia Workshop.

strengths:
• Captures spatial color relationships
• Goes beyond simple histograma
• Fast connected component análisis
• Complementary color signal
limitations:
• Lower precisión for complex scenes
• Sensitive to quantization parameters
• Limited without spatial context
• AI can produce diverse color regions
